meta_description: Steel City Electrics Ltd in Sheffield — trusted local electrician for installations, repairs and maintenance. NICEIC registered. Call us today.
hero_eyebrow: NICEIC Registered — Fast, Reliable Electrical Work
hero_subhead: Faulty socket or complete rewire — we diagnose and fix electrical problems fast, with honest pricing and no hidden charges.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full house rewires, we handle domestic and small commercial electrical work with professionalism and care.

services.title: Emergency Repairs
services.desc: Blown fuses, faulty sockets, and tripped electrics fixed fast. We carry common parts on the van and aim to diagnose most problems on your first visit.

services.title: Full House Rewires
services.desc: Outdated wiring puts your home at risk. We survey, quote, and install modern safe systems with minimal disruption — all work certified and guaranteed.

services.title: Boiler & Heating Controls
services.desc: Expert installation and repair of electric heating systems, immersion heaters, and smart controls to cut running costs and improve comfort.

services.title: Fault Finding & Testing
services.desc: Intermittent faults, persistent tripping, or electrical safety concerns. We use diagnostic equipment to pinpoint the problem and explain the fix clearly.

services.title: New Circuits & Additions
services.desc: Adding a socket for the kitchen, wiring a shed, or installing a dedicated circuit for a home office — done to current Building Regs and tested.

services.title: Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Old fuse boxes replaced with modern circuit breaker units, improving safety and making it easier to isolate individual circuits when needed.

about_pullquote: I started this because I got tired of seeing local folk overcharged for simple electrical work.
about_para_1: Steel City Electrics was founded 18 years ago by a tradesman who believed Sheffield deserved honest, straightforward electrical work at fair prices. We've grown from a one-man operation to a small, trusted team, but we've never lost sight of that principle. Every job — whether a rewire or a single socket — gets the same care and attention to detail.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we turn up on time, explain what's wrong in plain language, and charge what the work is actually worth. We hold NICEIC registration, follow current Building Regulations, and test everything we install. If you're local to Sheffield, you'll find us reliable, friendly, and quick.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Had an issue with sparking sockets in my Victorian terrace. Got a call within an hour, Matt came round and sorted it all. Turns out the whole circuit was dodgy — he explained it without the jargon and the price was spot on. Wouldn't go anywhere else now.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: Full rewire on a three-bed semi. A bit daunting, but the team made it stress-free. Minimal mess, they tidied up daily, and the work was finished a day early. Best part? We've had no problems since and the new electrics are dead silent. Brilliant blokes.
reviews.author: Angela K.

reviews.text: Emergency call on a Saturday evening — fuse box was playing up and we were worried it wasn't safe. They picked up immediately, came out within the hour, diagnosed a faulty breaker, and we were sorted by bedtime. Not cheap, but definitely worth it for the peace of mind.
reviews.author: Robert T.
